purpose: Review an original/proposed text pair with explicit local approve or reject decisions and asynchronous host callbacks.
behaviorProvider: React request lifecycle composed with shared AiCard, DiffView and Button.

requirements.statement: Treat the original/proposed pair as the review revision; changing either aborts the current operation and resets the local review state to pending.
Allow review only while not disabled, not awaiting a decision, status is pending, and original and proposed differ.
Pass original, proposed and an AbortSignal to decision callbacks; approve additionally receives proposed content. Ignore results for aborted or superseded operations.
A failed decision retains a pending review with an error and returns focus to the relevant decision control; success announces the decision and focuses its audit summary.
Support local decisions even when no approve/reject callback is supplied; the status does not prove that an external system changed.
Implement permissions, persistence, audit records and cancellation of remote work. An AbortSignal and ignored UI results cannot undo an already applied side effect.
Supply accurate original/proposed content, provenance, confidence and any controlled status. These displayed facts are not independently verified by the component.
Compose the shared read-only DiffView with collapsed unchanged content and first-change focus support; mode and maximum-height props configure the review presentation.
Own pattern or component styling consumes ai-assistance group tokens. Nested shared components retain their own group ownership; do not restyle their internals.

limitations: Approval is a local UI state, not security authorization or human certification.
No editing, merging, deployment, persistence or independently verified AI provenance.
Hosts must reconcile controlled status and honor cancellation where their backend allows it.
